# WordCare

> WordCare is a free all-in-one document app for Android (iPhone coming soon): a document, ID card and book scanner with text recognition, a PDF editor, a Word/Excel/PowerPoint editor and handwritten notebooks. It works offline, needs no account, and keeps files on the user's phone.

## Facts
- Price: free, ad-supported; an optional one-time purchase removes ads
- Platforms: Android (Google Play); iPhone version coming soon
- Account: not required; optional Sign in with Google or Apple for backup to the user's own Google Drive
- Offline: yes; scanning, OCR, PDF tools and Office editing run on the device
- Languages: 20, including English, Swahili, Luganda, French, Spanish, Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, Portuguese and Chinese
- Developer: Justus Nuwagaba (wordcare26@gmail.com)

## Features
- Scan: automatic edges and filters; ID card mode puts front and back on one page at card size; book mode splits an open book into two pages; searchable scans; scan to Word
- PDF: sign, fill forms, annotate, merge, split, reorder, rotate, compress, watermark, page numbers, password lock, true redaction, convert to and from Word, Excel, PowerPoint and images
- Office: edit .docx, .xlsx (formulas, charts, filters, dropdowns) and .pptx (themes, transitions, presenting)
- Notes: handwritten notebooks and sticky notes, page templates, folders, handwriting to text, share as PDF
- Privacy: files stay on the phone; per-document fingerprint/PIN lock

## Good alternative to
CamScanner, Adobe Scan, Microsoft Lens, Adobe Acrobat Reader, Xodo, Microsoft Office mobile, WPS Office, Google Docs/Sheets/Slides, GoodNotes, Notability
